ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal edge of the left lobe and scattered as fine linear/circular points across the medial sections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patch located at the upper-left peripheral boundary. Dense distribution of medium-contrast circular mottle points (~5-15 pixels in diameter) across both lobes. Distinct thin white linear streaks oriented diagonally on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible deep V-shaped central indentation with an acute angle; the vertex is sharply defined and divides the fluke into two distinct lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of serrations increases towards the outer tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges show a generally linear trajectory with a slight concavity approaching the central notch; leading edges exhibit a strong convex curvature towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of faint, circular, low-contrast pixel clusters consistent with healed barnacle attachment sites, most visible in the center-left and center-right lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, high-intensity linear disruptions (scratches) present on the left lobe, crossing the dark pigmentation at approximately 45-degree angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch or missing tissue section on the upper leading edge of the right lobe; highly serrated trailing edge indicates accumulated minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright white terminal patch on the far-left lobe tip provides a unique high-contrast landmark against the otherwise dark pigmentation.
